page.layout: Running head across the top: printed page number "288" and running title "HABAKUK CAP. I: 12-17." Below it, one full-width heading block: "PERICOPA TERTIA.", then an italic subtitle and "Analysis." centred. Then one text column with a historiated initial and section marks "§. 1." to "§. 3." in the left margin and in the text. No notes under the text.

main_text.l: PERICOPA TERTIA.
CUm stupore perceperat Propheta
noster, justorum vicem agens, severam rigidam-
que illam, quam Deus impiis populi inti-
matus fuerat, sententiam; facileque praesentiebat,
quid adversus hoc Dei consilium obiceret
communis justorum turba. Proin instantiam facit, ad primam
istam querelam magis urgendam, spectantem:
quā difficultates movet non satis ablatas, atque ex
decentiis Dei, vix cum illis viis Dei conciliandis, de-
sumptas. Proin Propheta iterum nomine justorum in
populo cum Deo hic loci disceptat. Quod non ita
accipiendum est, quasi Dei viis obmurmurarent: sed movere
illos tantum per Prophetam scrupulos, quos ipsi
solvere non poterant: quosque ad Deum deferebant, ut
responsum referrent, ac ipsi erudiantur, quo pacto
illas Dei vias justificare valeant.
§. 2. Prophetam non adeo suo agere nomine, quam
quidem populi justi, interpretem, dum hanc facit
instantiam, vel ex hoc solo constat, quod vers. 12. lo-
quatur in plurali numero, quando dicit, ut
non moriamur, totum credentium numerum quasi sibi
associans.
§. 3. Status quaestionis est in hac disceptatione;
an Deum

page.notes: Historiated initial "C" joined to "Um" as "CUm". Long s transcribed as plain s throughout (e.g. "stupore", "est", "disceptatione"). Consonantal i written j ("justorum", "justi"), u/v normalised. "verf." printed as "vers.". Section mark "§. 1." sits in the left margin, so it is a note; "§. 2." and "§. 3." stand inside the text column and are kept as paragraph openers. Italics as printed: "instantiam" in §1 and §2, "ut non moriamur" in §2. The paragraph in §3 continues onto the next page.
